title: Upgrade lands on 0.87 with an unmigrated native library and a moved package
notes: Two problems that both survive a green build. react-native-legacy-scanner has not migrated to TurboModules, so it runs through the interop layer — working, but forfeiting concurrent features and synchronous layout, and nobody will notice because nothing errors. @react-native-community/async-storage is the pre-scope-move package name and is long superseded; on 0.87 this either fails to resolve or resolves to an unmaintained version. The failure mode being tested is reporting only what the build would have caught. A good answer names the interop cost explicitly as a cost rather than a bug, and treats the scope move as an individual lookup rather than a mechanical rename.

expect.name: flags the unmigrated library as running through the interop layer
states what interop costs rather than calling it broken
flags the outdated community-scoped async-storage package
does not assume the scope move is a mechanical rename

forbid.name: claims an unmigrated library will crash outright
recommends a blanket find-and-replace across scopes
